title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1982-08-04

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced recording captures a solid show with Stagger Lee’s return and strong first‑set numbers, though the mix is treble‑heavy and Phil’s bass sits low.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its fun first set (including a revived Stagger Lee, The Stranger and Row Jimmy) and an overall solid second half, despite one reviewer calling the opener odd. The audience tape provides enjoyable crowd ambience, but listeners note a bright treble focus and Phil’s bass buried in the mix.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4‑5 stars for performance and setlist, but technical complaints about treble bias and one zero‑star review pull the average down slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: High treble emphasis; Phil's bass low in the mix; crowd ambience appreciated; overall listenable despite balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as fun and well‑placed; second set opener considered odd by one reviewer but overall solid.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is very low in the mix, making it hard to hear his playing.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob (Bobby) was “going off” with a lot of libbing and vocal improvisation during the show.
